items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ella, Sarah, Basie, Duke, Michael Jackson, Aretha, 50 Cent, Snoop Dogg. It’s ridiculous. I’m doing they album with Snoop Dogg...

ctx.x: . . . Ella, Sarah, Basie, Duke, Michael Jackson, Aretha, 50 Cent, Snoop Dogg. It’s ridiculous. I’m doing they album with Snoop Dogg and Clark Terry. That’s going to be great. They’re going to do mumbles. He’s going to rap bebop to hip-hop. I love that. Tony Bennett and Stevie – he asked me to do an album with him on Marvin Gaye songs – jazz. It’s great. Joe Pesci – one of the greatest jazz singers I ever heard in my life. Trust me. Eight years old. I used to hang out with him and Tommy Mottola and [Robert] DeNiro…
